2017.operative_part: Declares the election of one candidate of one list in the Central Bohemian Region invalid, declares another candidate of the same list elected, and resets that list's substitutes. First page read; candidates are not named here.
2017.national_list_votes_after_resolution: not established: the recalculated vote totals were not read
2017.published_vintage: original results; ČSÚ states that VOLPS201703 does not reflect the review

2021.operative_part: As summarised on ČSÚ's open-data page: a candidate's withdrawal in the South Moravian Region was invalid and the list's substitutes were reset; ČSÚ states the list of elected deputies is unchanged. The ruling itself was not read.
